Copy source files (NOT node_modules) ```powershell Copy-Item "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\listing-page-scan\SKILL.md" "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\.skill-publisher-staging\listing-page-scan\" Copy-Item "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\listing-page-scan\scripts\screenshot.mjs" "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\.skill-publisher-staging\listing-page-scan\scripts\" Copy-Item "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\listing-page-scan\scripts\package.json" "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\.skill-publisher-staging\listing-page-scan\scripts\" Copy-Item "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\listing-page-scan\scripts\package-lock.json" "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\.skill-publisher-staging\listing-page-scan\scripts\" ``` ### 3. Write README.md to staging Write a full README.md to the staging directory with this content: ```markdown
# Listing Page Scan **将任意网页截取为一张完整的连续长图（PNG）。** 自动处理弹窗关闭、懒加载触发、"View More" 展开、fixed/sticky 元素修正。逐屏滚动截图后拼接，不破坏轮播等依赖视口高度的布局。 [![Agent Skill](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent%20Skill-Compatible-blueviolet)](https://skills.sh) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
--- ## 核心功能 - **逐屏截图拼接**：通过 Puppeteer 逐视口滚动截图，再用 Sharp 拼接为连续长图 - **弹窗自动关闭**：检测并关闭 cookie banner、订阅弹窗等遮挡元素 - **懒加载触发**：滚动过程中自动触发图片和内容的懒加载 - **"View More" 展开**：自动点击展开按钮，确保截取完整内容 - **Fixed/Sticky 修正**：将 fixed 和 sticky 定位元素转为 static，避免重复出现在每屏截图中 --- ## 目录结构 ``` listing-page-scan/ ├── SKILL.md # 主指令文件 └── scripts/ ├── screenshot.mjs # 截图主脚本（Puppeteer + Sharp） ├── package.json # Node.js 依赖声明 └── package-lock.json # 锁定依赖版本 ``` --- ## 使用示例 > **用户**："帮我截取这个网页的全页长图：https://example.com/product" > > Skill 启动 Puppeteer，逐屏滚动截图并拼接为一张完整 PNG 长图。 > **用户**："扫描一下这个购买页" > > Skill 自动处理弹窗、展开折叠内容、修正 sticky 导航栏，输出干净的全页截图。 --- ## 安装依赖 首次使用前，在脚本目录安装 Node.js 依赖： ```bash cd ~/.cursor/skills/listing-page-scan/scripts npm install ``` 需要系统已安装 Chrome/Chromium（Puppeteer 使用 puppeteer-core，不自带浏览器）。 --- ## 迭代记录 见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。 --- ## 许可证 MIT ``` ### 4. Write CHANGELOG.md ```markdown # Changelog All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file. The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/), and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/). ## [1.0.0] - 2026-05-28 ### Added - Puppeteer 逐屏截图 + Sharp 拼接的全页长图方案 - 弹窗自动关闭（cookie banner、订阅弹窗等） - 懒加载触发（滚动时自动加载图片和内容） - "View More" 展开（自动点击展开按钮） - Fixed/Sticky 元素修正（转为 static 避免重复） - 视口高度敏感布局保护（不破坏轮播等组件） ``` ### 5. Write .gitignore ```gitignore # Runtime artifacts node_modules/ __pycache__/ *.pyc .DS_Store Thumbs.db # Backup files *.bak.* *.bak *.tmp *.swp # Generated outputs result-card-*.html *.tsv # Staging directory .skill-publisher-staging/ ``` ### 6. Generate LICENSE (MIT) Get the GitHub username with `gh api user -q ".login"`, then write a standard MIT LICENSE file with copyright 2026 and that username. ### 7. Git init, add, commit, create repo, push IMPORTANT: Wait until the file-sync subagent has cleaned up the staging directory, OR use a different staging path. Since we're running in parallel, use a unique staging path: ```powershell cd "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\.skill-publisher-staging\listing-page-scan" git init git add . git commit -m "Initial publish via github-skill-publisher" gh repo create listing-page-scan --public --source=. --push --description "Full-page screenshot tool: captures any webpage as a single continuous PNG image with auto popup dismissal and lazy-load handling." ``` ### 8. Clean up ```powershell cd "C:\Users\016551" Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "C:\Users\016551\.cursor\skills\.skill-publisher-staging" ``` If cleanup fails because the directory is in use, that's fine - it can be cleaned up later. ### 9. Return the final result Report: repo URL, file count, CHANGELOG version, and confidentiality status (CLEAN).
